payload.purpose_context: The 'charter new' scaffolder, the project-registration engine, and the bundle validator each derive a doctrine artifact's on-disk slug differently, so 'charter bundle validate' fails for any project that authors a project-tier directive (#4832) or activates a project profile (#4833). This mission adopts kebab-case as the single canonical filename/slug (internal id kept authored; id and slug decoupled), routes the scaffolder and engine through one slug_for helper with a manifest-driven validator, and extends the validator kind table to every registration-writing kind, so project-tier doctrine authoring reaches a clean bundle validate.
payload.purpose_tldr: Give doctrine artifacts one canonical on-disk slug so 'charter bundle validate' stops rejecting the registration engine's own records.

payload.question: Minimal fix (scaffolder kebab + 5-kind validator table) or durable fix (also shared slug_for helper + manifest-driven validator to close the drift class per DIRECTIVE_043)?

Migrate existing SCREAMING-filename project directives (which requires fixing the #4834 path-update gap in this mission), or go-forward only (new artifacts born clean; existing files + #4834 handled as follow-ups)?

reason: Loaded reviewer-renata + charter context --action review. Verified all subtasks T010-T016 against commit 13510c82b3 in lane-c. T010: engine now calls slug_for(kind, identifier); quote import removed and confirmed unused elsewhere in the file (quote lives inside WP01's slug_for). T011/#4834: early-continue now requires previous.slug==slug AND previous.content_hash==content_hash AND previous.path==resolved_path AND previous.provenance_path==resolved_provenance_path AND sidecar.is_file() before skipping -- drift on path/provenance now rewrites the entry, no sidecar deleted in that branch (test_path_and_provenance_drift_rewrites_manifest_entry_without_deleting_sidecar: plan.deletes==()). T012: previous.slug is reconciled against slug_for; a legacy non-canonical slug (e.g. LOVE_THY_ENEMY-style) is corrected and its orphaned sidecar queued for deletion -- test_legacy_non_canonical_directive_slug_reconciles_and_moves_sidecar proves the move end-to-end via the real engine. T013: doctrine.py _artifact_filename derives its stem via slug_for; verified by test_new_directive_scaffolds_kebab_filename_with_screaming_id_preserved. T014: convergence test (scaffolder==engine==manifest slug) and the namespaced path-escape guard (test_namespaced_profile_identity_cannot_escape_provenance_directory, team%2Fops-responder) both pass. T015: test_slug_canonicalization_e2e.py drives the real engine (author_guidance + plan/commit_project_registration), asserts validate_synthesis_state green and files byte-identical, plus an idempotent-replan test. RULING on scrutiny item 1 (inverted test): the OLD test_existing_manifest_identity_and_provenance_are_preserved hand-edited the manifest's slug field to an arbitrary value ('original-synthesis-slug') never produced by slug_for and asserted it survived verbatim -- this is the manifest (a derived/generated bookkeeping file, ManifestArtifactEntry, never operator-authored) pinning exactly the pre-fix #4834 bug the mission's own contract (registration-path-update-and-migration-contract.md, 'slug reuse caveat') requires fixing: 'must reconcile against slug_for(kind, id) and not perpetuate a legacy non-canonical slug.' The rename to test_existing_manifest_slug_is_reconciled_against_slug_for is a legitimate correction, not delete-the-assertion-not-the-test: it keeps the identity/provenance-preservation assertions (URN match, sidecar path/existence) and only replaces the incorrect 'arbitrary slug persists' assertion with 'slug is reconciled to canonical, legacy value does not survive' -- directly matching the contract text, not weakened to a tautology. RULING on scrutiny item 2 (sidecar delete): the T012 delete is legitimately in-scope (contract explicitly names 'the now-orphaned sidecar' as part of the slug-reuse-caveat fix, not a rename/migration). Traced the guard: provenance_path_for(kind,slug) is a pure function of (kind,slug); legacy_sidecar (previous.provenance_path, only collected when previous.slug != slug) can only collide with a path this same plan writes if two distinct manifest entries share (kind,slug), which duplicate-identity detection already prevents elsewhere. plan_project_registration filters deletes via stale_candidates - written (written = all paths in writes, computed once after the full artifact loop), so a legacy sidecar is only ever deleted when the canonical replacement was NOT that same path, and never when the plan just wrote to it.
